what: Pictures shown over the globe while the story is told: each a real object or a real photograph, with where it comes from. Times are seconds into the sentence named by `line` (the ids in source/engine/storytext.js); `where` keeps a picture clear of what the globe is showing (right, left or low-left). Every picture is in the public domain; the record of each, as Wikimedia Commons gave it on the day named, is in research/story-media/commons.json. The picture of Plato is the left half of Raphael's detail, cut so that it shows him alone.
